headline: Indian Markets Rally As Nifty Tops 22,900
bias_text: Indian equity benchmarks logged solid gains in the last session, with the Nifty 50 advancing 1.09% to 22,946.70 and the Sensex rising 1.18% to 74,113.11. Buying was strong across key sectors, supported by Bank Nifty which gained 1.18% alongside top single-stock performances in Adani Ports and Adani Enterprises. Lower crude oil prices and the US Federal Reserve keeping interest rates unchanged provided additional relief to domestic market sentiment.

vix.headline: India VIX 15.20 (-6.46%)
vix.text: India VIX declined by 6.46% to 15.20, indicating reduced market volatility during the session. The USD/INR pair edged up by 0.06% to settle at 95.24.

asia.head: Asian Markets Mixed On Tech
asia.text: Asian markets traded mixed as Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.10%, while China's Shanghai Composite dropped 0.82% and Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 0.59% amid a tech selloff. US markets logged modest gains following the Fed's decision to hold interest rates, with the S&P 500 up 0.28%. Meanwhile, European indices like the DAX and FTSE 100 also closed higher by 0.76% and 0.41% respectively.
